versions.content: Description of Data Exchange Point Shall Describe Work Prod- uct in Methodology Type: valid Description: The standardization template shall support description of the work product (i.e. artifact or deliverable) in the methodology which is represented by the description of data exchange point. E.g. via free text in combination with referencing the artifact in the methodology model Rationale: It should be clear to which artifacts in the AUTOSAR methodology the profile applies. Use Case: [UC_STDT_00020] Dependencies: – Supporting Material: –
